title: A clinical trial of raludotatug deruxtecan (R-DXd) in participants with ovarian cancer that has returned after treatment (MK-5909-008)
official: A Phase 3, Open-Label, Multicenter, Randomized Study of Raludotatug Deruxtecan (MK-5909, R-DXd) With or Without Bevacizumab Versus Standard-of-Care Platinum-Based Doublet Chemotherapy With or Without Bevacizumab in Participants With Advanced Platinum-Sensitive High-Grade Serous or High-Grade Endometrioid Epithelial Ovarian, Primary Peritoneal, or Fallopian Tube Cancer who Have Progressed During First-Line PARPi Maintenance (ENGOT-ov107 / GOG-3142 / REJOICE-Ovarian05)
summary:
Main objective: 1.	To compare R-DXd with or without bevacizumab to SOC platinum-based chemotherapy with or without bevacizumab with respect to PFS per RECIST 1.1 as assessed by BICR.
2.	To compare R-DXd with or without bevacizumab to SOC platinum-based chemotherapy with or without bevacizumab with respect to OS
conditions: Ovarian, Primary Peritoneal, or Fallopian Tube Cancer

interventions.name: MVASI 25 mg/mL concentrate for solution for infusion
Avastin 25 mg/ml concentrate for solution for infusion.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Has a histologically or cytologically documented advanced high-grade serous or high-grade endometrioid epithelial ovarian, primary peritoneal, or fallopian tube cancer
2. Has received 1 line of platinum-based therapy with a minimum of 4 cycles of platinum-doublet chemotherapy and have platinum-sensitive disease.
3. Has received a poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase inhibitor (PARPi) as maintenance treatment after the first line platinum-based chemotherapy course and experienced radiographic progression during treatment or within 42 days of the last dose of PARPi.
4. Has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1 assessed within 7 days before randomization.
5. Has recovered from any AEs due to previous anticancer therapies.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Has clear cell, mucinous, or sarcomatous histology, mixed tumors containing any histology, or low-grade/borderline ovarian cancer
2. Has a history of thrombotic disorders, hemorrhage, hemoptysis, or active GI bleeding within 6 months before randomization
3. Has uncontrolled or significant cardiovascular disease.
4. Has clinically severe pulmonary compromise resulting from intercurrent pulmonary illnesses including, but not limited to, any underlying pulmonary disorder (ie, pulmonary emboli within 3 months of randomization, severe asthma, severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease [COPD], restrictive lung disease, pleural effusion) and any autoimmune, connective tissue, or inflammatory disorders with potential pulmonary involvement (eg, rheumatoid arthritis, Sjogren’s syndrome, sarcoidosis), or prior pneumonectomy.
5. Has received chronic steroid treatment, with some exceptions
6. Has current, clinically relevant bowel obstruction (including subocclusive disease) including obstruction related to underlying epithelial ovarian cancer, abdominal fistula or GI perforation, intra-abdominal abscess, or evidence of rectosigmoid involvement by pelvic exam.
7. Has known additional malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the past 3 years.
